steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Contestant Mizuki gave up obstructing the ambush, headed on top of the arms shop ruins where Ch'en and Lin are buried, halted for a moment and then vanished without a trace.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: All of our surveillance and drones have been unable to locate him.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And of the teams at the head, Honey Summer has become the first to reach the swimming checkpoint.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: All the other teams up front are successively passing through, too.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: And as for our most arresting LUNG wRATh, Ernesto has already been toppled at the rear, and our staff have judged that he's lost the ability to fight on.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ch'en and Lin, our two heroines, still show no signs of movement.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Could this truly be where it all ends?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, you're kidding, right? This can't be the place, can it?

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Miss Hoshiguma really cares a lot about the competition.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: As if. She's got a ton of money riding on Ch'en. That's all.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: They've known each other for so long now. Who cares whether she wins or loses a competition like this?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Losing doesn't just mean something's up, and winning isn't gonna prove anything.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm hoping she loses, really. That's the excuse I need to make fun of her.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Here, Eyjafjalla. Closer. Let me try this facial cream on you. I think it'll make you look great.

steps.name: Eyjafjalla
steps.text: Alright, then. Thank you.
Suddenly, another boom resounds, coming from the screen whose shot is fixed on Ernesto's arms shop.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Hold on, could it be...
Onscreen, smoke pours forth, and out from it, pushing a bicycle, Ch'en and Lin Yühsia emerge.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: They're out, they're out! They're finally out!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Ch'en and Lin once again stand on the competition stage!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: However, the two only have one bicycle left, and the swimming checkpoint is still a distance away. And at this point, the lead pack have already started on the swim.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Do LUNG wRATh really still have a chance?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get moving. I'll run.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Hop on.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Don't make me repeat myself. Hop on.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're sure?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'll ride, you sort out anyone in the way.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: It's so beautiful. They only have one bicycle left, but Lin refuses to leave Ch'en behind.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: She's having Ch'en stand on her own bike's back seat, and as she cycles, Ch'en is ready to handle anyone with a mind to obstruct them.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Two people, one single bicycle, and an act of perfect coordination to leave us all in awe!

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: Dare I say that right now, their combination is the mightiest in this whole championship!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You stepped on my hair.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Enemies in front. I can't help it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Can you stop twisting?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Why don't you try pedaling?
Ch'en suddenly pushes Lin Yühsia's head down, narrowly avoiding a head-on collision with a tire.
Lin Yühsia then lifts her head back up, and fiercely knocks it into Ch'en's face.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yühsia, you—!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Accident.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: LUNG wRATh have broken through the final stretch at breakneck speeds, and reached the beach.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: The swimming checkpoint is right before their eyes.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: But the other teams clearly won't let them through that easily.

steps.name: D.D.D.
steps.text: A vicious beach battle is about to commence!
